When does Neuromancer premiere?
Neuromancer premieres January 22, 2027 on Apple TV.

Where can I watch Neuromancer?
Watch Neuromancer on Apple TV

Who stars in Neuromancer?
Neuromancer features Callum Turner, Briana Middleton, Mark Strong, Peter Sarsgaard, Joseph Lee, Clémence Poésy, Dane DeHaan, Marc Menchaca, Max Irons, Emma Laird, and more

What is Neuromancer about? 
A hacker and an assassin are thrust into a web of high-stakes crime as they take aim at a corporate dynasty.

What genre is Neuromancer?
Neuromancer is sci-fi/cyberpunk

What are other shows and movies like Neuromancer?
Shows and movies similar to Neuromancer are Altered Carbon, Blade Runner, Ghost in the Shell, The Matrix, Mr. Robot, Westworld, Devs, Black Mirror, and Severance.

snippet.title: Neuromancer - Official Teaser Trailer (Callum Turner, Mark Strong) | Comic Con 2026
snippet.description:
Check out the teaser trailer for Neuromancer, an upcoming 10-episode sci-fi series starring Callum Turner, Briana Middleton, Mark Strong, Joseph Lee, Peter Sarsgaard and Clémence Poésy. Neuromancer is based on the novel of the same name by William Gibson. Neuromancer premieres globally on Friday, January 22, 2027 on Apple TV with two episodes, followed by one new episode weekly, every Friday through March 19, 2027.

Neuromancer follows a damaged, top-rung super-hacker named Case (Turner) who is thrust into a web of digital espionage and high stakes crime with his partner Molly (Middleton), a razor-girl assassin to pull a heist on a corporate dynasty with untold secrets. The ensemble cast also includes Max Irons, Dane DeHaan, Junia Rees, Jordan Kouamé, Emma Laird, Marc Menchaca, André De Shields and Isabella Pappas.

Produced by Paramount Television Studios and Anonymous Content, the series is created for television by Graham Roland and JD Dillard. Roland also serves as showrunner, and he and Dillard executive produce alongside David Levine, Garrett Kemble and Zack Hayden for Anonymous Content; Aubrey ‘Drake’ Graham, Adel ‘Future’ Nur and Jason Shrier for DreamCrew Entertainment; Jennifer Haley and William Gibson also executive produce. JD Dillard serves as director on the first three episodes.

#IGN #SDCC

snippet.title: Avengers Doomsday New Leaked Trailer (Comic Con Trailer)
snippet.description:
#avengers #avengersdoomsday #marvel 
Avengers: Doomsday is one of the most anticipated upcoming blockbusters in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU). Officially announced by Marvel Studios at San Diego Comic-Con, the film marks a massive shift in Phase 6 of the Multiverse Saga, effectively taking the place of the previously planned Avengers: The Kang Dynasty.

Here are the key highlights that make this film a huge event for cinema fans:

The Return of Robert Downey Jr.: In a twist that stunned the fanbase, Robert Downey Jr. is returning to the MCU—not as Tony Stark / Iron Man, but as the iconic comic book villain Victor von Doom / Doctor Doom. Bringing back the actor who built the franchise to play its next ultimate antagonist is one of Marvel's boldest creative gambles yet.

The Russo Brothers Take the Helm: Directors Anthony and Joe Russo, who delivered hit films like Captain America: The Winter Soldier, Avengers: Infinity War, and Avengers: Endgame, are back to direct Doomsday alongside screenwriter Stephen McFeely.

Setting Up Secret Wars: Doomsday serves as the crucial setup for the climax of the Multiverse Saga. It will unite heroes across different timelines and dimensions to face Doctor Doom, directly leading into the reality-warping events of Avengers: Secret Wars.

Slated for release in May 2026, the movie aims to recreate the high-stakes, event-style storytelling that made the finale of the Infinity Saga a global phenomenon.

Avengers: Doomsday pushes the Marvel Cinematic Universe into its most dangerous era as reality begins to fracture beyond repair. Across the multiverse, entire civilizations disappear without warning, ancient timelines collapse, and heroes find themselves trapped between worlds. At the center of the catastrophe stands Doctor Doom, whose vision extends far beyond conquest. Rather than destroy reality, Doom intends to rebuild it under a single, absolute order where every universe answers to him. The trailer delivers breathtaking multiversal action, stunning visual effects, and a darker, more cinematic tone that raises the stakes for every Marvel hero.

snippet.title: Toto - Africa (Lyrics)
snippet.description:
Toto - Africa (Lyrics)

🔔 Turn on notifications to stay updated with new uploads!

Lyrics:

[Instrumental Intro]

[Verse 1: David Paich]
I hear the drums echoin' tonight
But she hears only whispers of some quiet conversation
She's comin' in, 12:30 flight
The moonlit wings reflect the stars that guide me towards salvation
I stopped an old man along the way
Hopin' to find some old forgotten words or ancient melodies
He turned to me as if to say
"Hurry, boy, it's waitin' there for you"

[Chorus: Bobby Kimball]
It's gonna take a lot to drag me away from you
There's nothin' that a hundred men or more could ever do
I bless the rains down in Africa
Gonna take some time to do the things we never had
Ooh, ooh

[Verse 2: David Paich]
The wild dogs cry out in the night
As they grow restless, longing for some solitary company
I know that I must do what's right
As sure as Kilimanjaro rises like Olympus above the Serengeti
I seek to cure what's deep inside
Frightened of this thing that I've become

[Chorus: Bobby Kimball]
It's gonna take a lot to drag me away from you
There's nothin' that a hundred men or more could ever do
I bless the rains down in Africa
Gonna take some time to do the things we never had
Ooh, ooh

[Instrumental Break]

[Bridge: David Paich & Bobby Kimball]
"Hurry, boy, she's waiting there for you"

[Chorus: Bobby Kimball]
It's gonna take a lot to drag me away from you
There's nothin' that a hundred men or more could ever do
I bless the rains down in Africa
I bless the rains down in Africa (I bless the rains)
I bless the rains down in Africa (I bless the rains)
I bless the rains down in Africa
I bless the rains down in Africa (I'm gonna take the time)
Gonna take some time to do the things we never had
Ooh, ooh

[Instrumental Outro]

snippet.title: ORC INCREMENTAL Is A Perfectly Balanced Game With No E̲X̲P̲L̲O̲I̲T̲S̲
snippet.description:
Welcome to a brand new perfectly balanced video game from the publisher of Cookie Clicker. This is Orc Incremental The incremental auto battler. Where you build an orc army, watch it fight, and make it unstoppable! Now I am the spiffing brit breaker of video games as I love to find overpowered bugs, glitches and exploits inside of them to do silly things and this game is no different! It might be a demo for  an unreleased game but that will not stop me!

So what is Orc Incremental well it is rather simple you start with a single orc and build an unstoppable dark army to conquer the realms in this incremental auto battler. Perfect your formation, summon mighty beasts, unlock powerful upgrades, and grow stronger with each rebirth. Think of it like cookie clicker but we make money by defeating armies of good and happy elves working with knights and peasants. 
This is NOT sponsored but you can checkout the game on steam here and give it a Wishlist if you like: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4047270/Orc_Incremental/

-----------------------------------------------------------------
Assassin's Creed Odyssey is a 2018 action role-playing game developed by Ubisoft Quebec and published by Ubisoft. It is the eleventh major installment in the Assassin's Creed series and the successor to Assassin's Creed Origins (2017). Like its predecessor, the game features a large open world and adopts many elements from the role-playing genre, putting more emphasis on combat and exploration than stealth. Naval combat from previous titles in the series also plays a prominent role in Odyssey. The game's plot tells a mythological history of the Peloponnesian War between Athens and Sparta from 431 to 422 BCE. Players control a Spartan mercenary, who fights on both sides of the conflict as they attempt to find their family and eliminate the mysterious Cult of Kosmos. Odyssey also continues the story arc of Layla Hassan, who relives the mercenary's memories through the Animus device to find a powerful artifact.
~ Wikipedia

snippet.description:

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Game Over screens are meant to stop you in your tracks, but sometimes game designers decided to go completely off the rails and make failure bizarre, hilarious, and strangely brutal. In this episode of Fact Hunt, Guru Larry takes a look at some of the most ridiculous, confusing, and unexpectedly dark Game Overs ever put into video games — from planet-destroying curiosity in Commander Keen, to spine-snapping forbidden knowledge in Alone in the Dark, to the bizarrely tragic ending of The New Zealand Story, the unfair nonsense of Return to Zork, and the shockingly grim punishment lurking in California Games 2.

So buckle up for a trip through the daftest defeats, the laughable losses, and the most unhinged ways a game has ever told you that you have failed. If you enjoy retro gaming oddities, dark humour, and the sort of trivia that makes game designers look mildly unwell, you are in the right place.

Like, comment, subscribe, and ring the bell for more retro gaming madness from Guru Larry and Fact Hunt.

And yes, before you ask, I'm "That Guru Larry" that was on TV 😂
